Use an aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate.
Treat the cooling as a temperature change of ΔT = −180 K.
Use α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Compute the thermal-mismatch strain in the film as ε = (α_s − α_f) × ΔT.
The result is ε = +0.0027, which is 0.27% tensile strain.
If the convention defines mismatch strain as (α_f − α_s) × ΔT, report the magnitude as 0.0027 and state the sign convention explicitly.
